description.value: España Restaurant is a Spanish tapas restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, offering an extensive menu of traditional and modern Spanish dishes ranging from patatas bravas and grilled Humboldt squid to daily paella and a substantial charcuterie and cheese board program. The restaurant carries a tightly curated all-Spanish wine list with options by the glass. Its location near the Stanley Park Seawall makes it a natural dinner destination for cyclists riding the West End corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (6 spaces) at 67m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m; stands (4 spaces) at 96m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms this is an active Spanish tapas restaurant at 1118 Denman Street, Vancouver BC, V6G 2M8, with a current menu, wine list, and online reservations via Resy. The website provides no information about bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or takeout; several clearly vegetable-based dishes appear on the menu (Fried Chickpeas, Charred Winter Squash, Roasted Spiced Eggplant, Patatas Bravas, Marinated Beets, cheese board) constituting positive textual evidence of vegetarian options. A discrepancy exists between OSM hours (Th-Su) and the website (Wed-Sun), and no phone number appears in either source.
concerns: Opening hours discrepancy: OSM lists Th-Su 16:00-22:00 but website states 'Open Wednesday to Sunday Dinner 5pm - 10pm' — OSM omits Wednesday and may have inaccurate times.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website.
Minor name spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'España Restaurant' (with tilde) while the website consistently renders it as 'Espana Restaurant' (without tilde).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active sit-down Spanish restaurant confirmed open via a current website with menu, wine list, and online reservations, located on a key cycling corridor near Stanley Park.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes multiple clearly vegetarian dishes: Fried Chickpeas, Marinated Beets & Ajo Blanco, Charred Winter Squash, Roasted Spiced Eggplant, Patatas Bravas, plus a five-cheese selection board

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Main dishes $24–$38; tapas-focused Spanish with curated wine list
